DO LLMS RECOGNIZE YOUR PREFERENCES? EVAL-UATING PERSONALIZED PREFERENCE FOLLOWING IN LLMS

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Evaluates whether LLMs 'infer, memorize and adhere to user preferences' in multi-session conversations up to 100k tokens, using 3,000 preference-query pairs. The project page links amazon-science/PrefEval and an HF dataset (siyanzhao/prefeval_explicit).
